data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 justifies sustaining the flags by citing SRC_006 and SRC_008 as 'independent' peer-validators of SRC_005. But these very peers were themselves admitted via failure verdicts SRC_007 and SRC_009 that SRC_001 simultaneously treats as downstream CONSEQUENCES of SRC_005's validation. The target thus uses the validators' own legitimacy (the output of the propagation it is trying to justify) as part of the upstream validation path, producing circular epistemic support rather than the independent confirmation the adjudication ritual requires.
